comment: ANCHOR: WATCH_PROSPECTS_20261022 — Watch redesign (Gate 3 mockup, operator directive 2026-10-22): one lane per
security (held → Manage; expired/invalidated → Expired; proposable and not Trade-AI-failed → Actionable; desk
NEAR → Re-entry; else Setup forming), size caps with the overflow named, conflicts kept with both values/sources/
times and never resolved (AGENTS.md §26.5), ONE next step (Protect first > Resolve conflict > Propose / Set alert),
no BEHAVIOR_FIELDS key in the payload, cio_prospect projection preferred when live else the labelled interim
adapter, one route and one catalog entry, list_watch_intelligence and the adapter share compose_universe.
